name: locally-uncensored
description: Use the AI models running on this computer from Claude: local chat models and ComfyUI image generation.
long_description: Connects Claude to the local backends Locally Uncensored runs or detects: its built-in engine, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, KoboldCpp and other OpenAI compatible servers, plus ComfyUI for images. Prompts and images never leave the machine.

tools.name: lu_status
tools.description: Shows which local chat backends and ComfyUI are running, with their models.

tools.name: list_local_models
tools.description: Lists the chat models served by the online local backends.

tools.name: local_chat
tools.description: Sends a prompt to a local model and returns its answer.

tools.name: comfyui_list_models
tools.description: Lists ComfyUI checkpoints, diffusion models, LoRAs, samplers and schedulers.

tools.name: comfyui_generate_image
tools.description: Renders an image from a prompt with an all-in-one checkpoint.

tools.name: comfyui_run_workflow
tools.description: Runs any API-format ComfyUI workflow and returns its files.

tools.name: comfyui_get_result
tools.description: Fetches the files of a ComfyUI job started with wait=false.

comfyui_url.title: ComfyUI URL
comfyui_url.description: Where ComfyUI answers. LU starts it on port 8188.

backends.title: Chat backends (optional)
backends.description: Comma separated id=url list, e.g. ollama=http://localhost:11434/v1. Empty probes every backend LU knows on its default port.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long a chat answer or a render may take.
